nom: La Roche-Posay Toleriane Double Repair Face Moisturizer with Niacinamide

avis.texte: I got a sample from my derm when I had a rash, and this was great. My skin didn't sting or burn with this, and it glides on smoothly. My skin is hydrated and I feel like it also makes it plump. No oily or greasy shine - love.

I have rosacea and sensitive. I bought several products and this double repair moisturizer was one of them. 1st time my face burned and was red 2nd day same thing. I checked online and I was using them in the wrong order. Use in order & it's perfect
I love this moisturizer. It always makes my skin feel hydrated and soft; it doesn't irritate my sensitive skin.

The quantity of naicnimide and actives ingridients is too high. Damaged my barrie cause acne all over my face. I thought it would help repair my barrier and bright my skin. But i was wrong. Woukd not recommend to sensitive skin at all!!

avis.titre: I will be buying this again!
avis.texte: As a teenager, I have very sensitive skin and I don't struggle with acne or oily skin, but my face is normal to dry And I've been using this moisturizer for over a year and is amazing!
This doesn't make my skin itchy, does not make me breakout, it hydrates bit peels and balls up in white, rubbery flakes everywhere.
After putting this on, if peels off my skin. Its not good to wear under makeup.

when if first got this i like it alot. after using it on a daily basis for about 3 months, it has become the item i dread using. the pilling is gross and annoying, you cant layer other products with this at all. it leaves me greasy, and since using it ive actually developed this ugly red patch on my eyelids. i wont be using it again
I love this product! I have dry acne prone skin and this has helped me so much. Going to make sure I always have this on hand!

I love this stuff! Ive never actually enjoyed putting lotion on my face and sticking to a daily routine until I found this. I keep buying it. I put this on everyday before I do makeup. It is not greasy at all, it goes on so easily and isnt sticky. If youre really dry you may need more but its perfect for daily use on combo skin
This product leaves your skin feelings hydrated and not sticky like most skin care products can. And it isn't an ashy moisturizer either.
I have used this in and off for a bit. I went back to it when I started using Tretnoin from the dermatologist and it was making me peel. This helped with peeling during the day.

avis.titre: Pills like crazy and NEVER absorbs
avis.texte: Tried this for my very dry and sensitive skin, and it does not work at all. The moisturizer never absorbs into my skin. I can't put sun screen or makeup on over it. The product just pills up, even 3 hours after applying it.

I have been searching and trying different moisturizers for a couple of months and after trying multiple i finally decided to try this one. i use the face wash so it made sense to pair it with the moisturizer. Glad i did. feels super fresh and hydrating and doesnt make me feel oily or shiny in a bad way. im glad i found my skin care holy grail.

Listen, I love this product, it's great for my sensitive, rosacea-ridden skin. However, I'm getting to the end of the product and it is near impossible to squeeze the packaging and get more lotion out! The shape is way too wide making it hard to squeeze, and I do have normal sized hands so I should be able to do this.

avis.titre: Don't get this one unless you want pilling
avis.texte: It looks great and luminous. Finally glass skin...until one day you decide not to go to bed within an hour of applying. All of a sudden CHUNKS of the product will pill. You will think OMG i need to exfoliate better. Then you get home from a facial and feel dry, put this on and pilling again. It is this. Not your makeup, not your milky toner, not their facewash because I do enjoy the brand but THIS. Skip this.

An Ulta associate recommended this and she was spot on. I have super sensitive dry skin & this lotion neither burns or irritates. Very affordable compared to my previous moisturizer. It has little or no fragrance which is a plus for me too. Will purchase again.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again and again!!
avis.texte: Bought this for the first time a few weeks ago and i absolutely love it!! It is very moisturizing and last a long time. I use it before bed and makes my skin look and feel amazing.

avis.titre: I was t so sure…I'm 100% sold now!!
avis.texte: I was so nervous when I saw the texture that it would break me out but honest to goodness I've been using it for about 3 weeks now and have not had a single blemish pop up which is in and of itself unusual for me!! My husband uses it also and he has rosacea. Again we were a little nervous with it being a thicker moisturizer BUT honest to goodness it's AMAZING for us BOTH!! And yes we are actual purchasers and did NOT receive this for any type of incentivized review.
I use this multiple times a day, works well, feels good on my skin, protects from sunburn, and never makes me break out
It's just like any other face moisturizer. Nothing special or extraordinary about it! I think La Roche Posey is just a hyped brand. But there is nothing truly special about it
I use a makeup cloth and this soap to clean, it does a great job.Buy the refill when you run out.
It's a good basic moisturizer, it's not too heavy on my sensitive acne prone skin and it layers well under my makeup.
Feels great on my face without being oily. However I feel like by the end of day I do need to reapply.
I have rosacea. Not only does this cream calm my condition but it makes my skin look ten years younger, moist and dewy. I'm 75. So these things are super important to me.
Its nice. Too hydrating but peels like crazy. I think this product need to be reformulated so that it doesnt peels off.

I feel like this moisturizer is just too heavy for my skin and it caused a lot of my breakouts and clogged pored. I'm currently switching to another moisturizer, but I also did my research on it, and based on my skin: normal to dry, this is just too heavy for me, especially for the summer. I will keep usingit though, with my tret because it is very moisturize I just wouldn't use it for the daily basis.

avis.titre: Developed allergic reaction after a year of use
avis.texte: Ive used this moisturizer for over a year, and as I recently bought a new bottle, I noticed a burning sensation and redness on my face. I tested it two more times to confirm the cause of these reactions and unfortunately it was this moisturizer. Highly disappointed.

avis.titre: Safe and effective, but pills like crazy!
avis.texte: The ingredients are great. It's reasonably priced. It gave me some moisture without clogging my pores. But it pills badly especially under makeup. It would be great if it weren't for the texture.
I really LOVE this moisturizer for my sensitive skin ! It avtually reduced my redness and made me combo skin feel so smooth and hydrated without a greasy feeling
I have been using this product for 5 years recommend by my dermatologist, it is a great moisturizer, I highly recommend it!

avis.titre: I will buy this product again and again because I am now add
avis.texte: This is an amazing product/amazing brand. It does exactly what it's made for, I have really dropped it again, especially after using a face wash. This literally put the glow back into your face.
My face is dry and red during the winter months. This moisturizer is extremely soothing and my skin looks nourished.

avis.titre: Quench the thirst! Your skin will thank you!
avis.texte: I love this face lotion! It's nearly weightless, and has a refreshing water "cooling" feel. Sometimes lotions leave my face red or make me feel like a glazed donut - not in a cute way… really impressed with this product so far!

I have dry skin and usually break out with most moisturizers. THIS has been a game changer for my skin. There is no more stretching feeling on my forehead. I also have sensitive skin and too many allergies. I will buy this over and OVER again. The price feels a little heavy BUT it is worth it. Good luck besties!

I continue to purchase this product! Great product! No smell! Lightweight! Put it in every morning and evening! I have sensitive skin and this product it awesome! Definitely moisturizing and leaves skin glowing!

Hydrating but I had "fungal acne"and felt tho it emphasized my texture and bumps. It would stay on all day no need to re apply. Moisture was good . It is noncomedogenic but I felt it cause minor pore clogging ? I switched to tatcha water cream and I see a lot less texture and my pores aren't clogged hope this helps!

avis.titre: Best moisturizer when your skin is trying to attack you
avis.texte: Super hydrating, rubs in easily, maybe takes a little bit to dry and can feel slightly oily, but that's a small price to pay when before using this, my face would be dry and flaky halfway through the day.
I have dry skin and this is the best moisturizer I've bought! No complaints about this product

This is hands down the best night moisturizer I have tried as someone with sensitive, combination, and acne-prone skin. This product was recommended by my dermatologist and it does not cause pilling or breakouts at all, even when used under makeup.

The reviews about the pilling were unfortunately spot on. Will be returning. Love the SPF version though and was hoping I could use this as a night time face moisturizer. Back to the drawing board. For reference I have dry, sensitive skin.

avis.titre: Best for people with oily skin
avis.texte: This moisturizer was okay. It doesnt have a lot of unnecessary ingredients so im sure it would be good sensitive. My skin is dry at the moment so I used it for that but it was great. Doesn't absorb well and will actually peel off if you use a lot of it

I wanted to like this because I hae really dry skin, sadly the product didnt absorb well and just completely rubbed off. I would still be putting it on my face and it would just roll in to clumps. I dont reccomend this product.
I thought I was going crazy when I had a burning sensation after using this bc of all the hype but yeah, it did sting. Also flakes and made my makeup look flaky.
Great for acne/acne prone skin. Moisturize but lightweight. I love the ingredients. Definitely recommend

Goes on smooth but PILLS the moment it dries if you touch your face with anything. DOES NOT work with any other products bc of this. Aside from pilling it dries to a matte very thin layer with no hydration or plumpness. I thought this was supposed to keep you feeling moisturized but it disappears and you feel the need to add more. 0/10 i would not ever use this even if free.

avis.titre: You get way more than you pay for with this moisturizer.
avis.texte: My previous moisturizer had increased in price until I could no longer justify the expense, I tried this and it outperformed the more expensive one in every way. My skin feels firmer yet soft to the touch. A little bit goes a long way and my skin absorbs it completely without feeling oily or sticky. I use it in the morning and with my retinol serum at night.
I buy this cream all the time! It's the best ever thing that keeps my face smooth and healthy looking. I get compliments all the time ! And for being 66, it helps me stay wrinkle free!!
If u think ur going to slather this on think again! This product pills like crazy! U cannot put makeup on without extreme technique and it still rolls up .. Get vanicream I'm telling u!
I have been using LaRoche Posey for over a year or more. My skin loves this moisturizer! This is one of my staples!

avis.titre: Love this product could be better
avis.texte: I love this product and how it hydrates my skin my only issue is it does peel easily on the skin sometimes

avis.titre: Great for sensitive and acne prone skin
avis.texte: Recommend by my Dermatologist because I have sensitive skin and cystic acne. The moisturizer is so dewy and really penetrates without clogging pores. I'm also 59, so it's great for aging skin too!
Went on my skin fine and felt like it absorbed. But after it dries it just pills like crazy.

avis.titre: Gentle moisturizer, but pills up on your skin!
avis.texte: I was excited to use this lotion for the first time. I have sensitive skin, and am anyways on the lookout for a gentle unscented moisturizer. I THOUGHT this was it. But a few hours after applying, I wiped my mouth with a napkin (after eating) and noticed lots of little white dots. I was unsure where they came from, so I went and checked in a mirror, and discovered that the lotion had pulled up all over my face, and my (almost black) eyebrows looked grey and like I had dandruff. And this is even without trying to put any makeup on top ! I was so sad! I love everything else about this lotion, but if it makes my face look all flakey and gross, it's a no go. Now I'm just going to have to use it as a night cream until it's gone... I wouldn't recommend.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again and again
avis.texte: And I have purchased it multiple times. It is the only thing I have found that will take care of the dry flaky spots that pop up on my face in the winter time. This alone is more than enough reason for me to re-purchase.
Great face and body moisturizer. Never miss a step in my skin care routine. if you're looking for a great moisturizer, here's your go to.
It's the perfect moisturizer for my combo skin. Not greasy, no odors.

avis.titre: I buy this product all the time
avis.texte: I am using this face cream along with the face wash for many years now. These are excellent products.

I felt like I would never get this winter flaking under control. I also struggle with clogged pores and blackheads. I bought this hoping it would help, and it worked wonders. It worked better than expected. I used it with The Ordinary Hyaluronic Acid 2% + B5 serum and La Roche-Posay Cicaplast B5 Soothing Spray. My skin has felt and looked hydrated all day. My skin has never looked this good. I would recommend this to anyone with dry, flaky, acne-prone skin. This is hands down the best product I have purchased!!
I have sensitive skin and was scared to use this product, but I've been using it for a month and I love it. No breakout. Loving my skin now

I purchased this product thinking it would be a good addition to my daily regimen. Unfortunately, it burned so bad that I couldn't use it. I don't have sensitive skin and can pretty much use anything but this product was awful. It left my face sensitive for a few days even after I stopped using it, especially around my eye area.

avis.titre: I'm on my third tube of this.
avis.texte: My skin is changing and my moisturizers began to burn when applied. This doesn't burn and it's recommended for acne prone skin, which I have. It will occasionally pill if you rub it, so I don't use it under makeup, but I do at night and to workout.

Started using this after developing rosacea, and it has helped tremendously. A little goes a long way, and is very hydrating. I'm very prone to breakouts from creams and moisturizers and this stuff is fantastic.

Tried this product and understand why it gets good reviews and is popular. It has a build in spf which is so needed for my skin and absorbs really well into my skin. It goes on thick but blends in so easily. There was no irritation when applying and my skin is visibly hydrated for a long duration. I don't feel the caked effect like other lotions which is great. I do wish it lasted longer than it does but it could be that my skin is extra dry.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This serum is FANTASTIC! It goes on so smoothly and is a very lightweight hydration cream. It leaves my face feeling so soft and rejuvenated. Laroche has a slight scent to it that I don't mind at all, it's not a perfume but more like a sunscreen and lotion mix scent- if you're sensitive to smells. I only used a few drops and applied it evenly and while other brands irate my skin lariche Passat did not. I would absolutely recommend if you are looking to hydrate and nourish your skin or are looking for a product to help with aging or stress!
My favorite moisturizer I've tried - thick consistency and leaves skin glowy

I always use ponds in my face but changing to this mosturizer was the best choice I could make. It is transparent and goes smoothly in the face without making you look greasy. Does not take long to dry and serves well with a small amount. I will buy it again fs
Finally, something that works! I could feel and see the improvement of my skin. To prevent piling, I had to let it sit for 8-10 minutes. It paired well with my BOJ sunscreen and makeup too.

avis.titre: Not great for super dry flaky skin
avis.texte: I actually was meant to get the triple repair lol but got this. It's definitely not meant for dry flaky skin. It does have a lotion texture and is geasy. I think if you jut need regular moisturizer this might be good for you but for me not my type!
I used the cleanser and this moisturizer and even tested them out separately to make sure and they completely broke me out.

I was actually able to get help from a sales woman on the floor. She found everything on the list for me, so helpful . It was nice not feeling like I was putting someone out. Michigan could learn something from the southern area. Kind, friendly and willing to happily help. Thank you Florida.

This moisturizer is so good and thick and is great for dry skin especially in the winter months. However, i had it on under makeup and i noticed it starting pilling like really really bad. I tried wearing it without makeup and it still would pill on my skin so bad. Its sad because this is a really good moisturizer for my dry skin. :(((

avis.titre: Pills so much- it's so annoying
avis.texte: Pills a lot and its really annoying. Its super lightweight which isnt whar im looking for. They also arent cruelty free so im nlt repurchasing
I've had a problem with Pityriasis Alba for years. It always popped up during the Summer. I got this product back in August and it helped me get rid of the light, white, ashy spots on my face.
Honestly I like it! A little goes along way. Will be purchasing another!

I bought the small version of this on a whim while getting all new products for my skincare routine. Within 2 days my acne got better, this stuff + their purifying face wash for oily skin is the only reason my skin is so clear over a month later. And its on sale for less than 20$ right now for the full size. i highly recommend
They really need to stop marketing this as safe for sensitive or acne-prone skin because it's not.

avis.titre: not good for acne prone skin
avis.texte: it's very hydrating, but it's also a very heavy moisturizer. if you have combo/acne prone skin then I wouldn't recommend this. I started breaking out after using for about a month, and I haven't broken out since then.
I agree with the reviewer who said it felt moisturizing and went on well, but her face felt dry. I was really disappointed in it.

This is the best moisturizer ever! I only use it at night; long story short - i ran out of it a while back and decided to try something different (and more expensive). A few months pass, and i think, "man i'm aging rapidly." I remembered this moisturizer i picked up in the travel size randomly one day and slapped it on one night recently. The very next morning, I could barely even tell i had pores lol. That sounds ridiculous, but it's true. I LOVE this moisturizer and will purchase it until the end of time.
This feels nice when applying but it doesnt sink in well and it pills up

avis.titre: I will buy this product again and again.
avis.texte: Highly recommend. This had made my skin so soft. I have oily skin generally and this product does not make me break out or leave my face feeling greasy. I would recommend this to all ages. Very good. Very happy and satisfied. This product has really made a difference.
It pills up even when not layered with other products. Even trying the press in method. Leaves a weird layer on your face.
its not as moisturizing as I would expect/hope for. but its ok.

Unfortunately this didn't work for my skin. I have acne prone sensitive skin. First time i used it i started getting zits with majority of them being on my forhead. I quit using it and skin cleared up. A couple weeks later i tried again with the same result. Other than that the texture was great and lighweight and my skin felt great (minus the breakouts)
The product feels fine abd absorbs well, but the moisture doesn't last. Day or night, my skin feels dry and tight within a few hours.
I use this product twice a day every day… it rejuvenates my skin…. 66 yr… NO WRINKLES… smooth skin…. I love it! N

I'm currently trying to repair my barrier and as soon as i applied this moisturizer, my skin started stinging like crazy, it hurt and had to rinse my face instantly to get it off and let my skin red. Niacinamide could be the culprit or the formulation change
I have very sensitive skin and have developed in later life, anxiety, induced eczema, and this product is amazing for it.
This product leaves the skin with an incredible, very hydrated texture.
This moisturizer is a great addition to my skincare. It makes my skin feel bouncy and look glowy. Definitely recommend!!

I was a little hesitant to try this moisturizer because I'd seen a lot of negative reviews, but my skin drinks it up like water in the desert. I have combination to dry, sensitive skin, and this is one of the few moisturizers that actually leaves my skin feeling truly satisfied once it absorbs. It keeps my skin hydrated without feeling greasy or heavy and leaves a smooth, glowy finish that lasts throughout the day One of the biggest challenges for me has been finding a moisturizer that works under my mineral sunscreen. Even with products that should be compatible, like a water-based sunscreen over a water-based moisturizer, my SPF still flakes or pills no matter how long I wait before applying it. With this one, I usually wait just 5-10 minutes and my sunscreen glides on perfectly, stays in place all day, and doesn't disturb the moisturizer underneath. This has made it a staple in my morning routine. It's fragrance-free, but it also doesn't have that odd "fragrance-free" smell, which I really appreciate. The texture is lightweight yet nourishing, and it doesn't irritate my skin or clog my pores. I've never had breakouts from it. I'm already on my third bottle, which says a lot because I usually rotate through products pretty quickly.

I have very sensitive combonation skin and acne prone skin and live in a very dry climate. I go for something moisturizing and this is NOT it. Its almost greasy? and doesnt absorb well. Also make me break out.

It feels really nice when applying and skin feels very hydrated right after. It does pill a lot. Also, by the end of the month using this product, my acne flared like crazy. I would recommend as hand cream or something so it doesnt go to waste.

I always try out different skin care brands in hopes of finding a new favorite. I purchased the mini size just in case I didn't liked it. Well, I absolutely hated this product. After getting out of the shower, applying toner, and serum, I applied the moisturizer. My eyes started watering and I thought it could have been that my eyes were dry. I did the same routine the very next day before work. By the time I had gotten to work, my eyes watering, tears down my face, burning, nose running, and sneezing. Throughout the day, my coworkers kept asking me if I was okay because my eyes were THAT SWOLLEN. I tried eye drops multiple times to wash out my eyes, it did not work. I went to the bathroom and finally decided to wash my face with water. I got some relief but, nothing really made my symptoms go away until I completely washed my face and took a benedryl. I recommend skipping this product entirely and going with Clinique moisture surge or a Pur moisturizer!!!
Thought this was a good brand. It still might be, but their moisturizer could be better

avis.titre: Great for oily or combo skin
avis.texte: Loved this moisturizer, it doesn't add any de wines so if you naturally have oilier skin it is perfect.

One of the best facial moisturizers Ive ever purchased. I my skin has never been super proned to acne but I would occasionally break out. After using this product I have not broken out SINCE (even during menstrual) and its been over two months since Ive been using it. For the price point there is a good amount of product and lasts you months so youre really getting your moneys worth. Keep in mind a little goes a long way with thus product. I pair it with the face wash and let me tell you, the discourlation that Ive had for years is beginning to fade and my skin is BRIGHT!!! Highly recommend this brand/product.
Works great for my super sensitive skin. It hydrates without clogging pores or feeling greasy.

avis.titre: Not a great base for other products
avis.texte: Unfortunately this product pills like crazy when i apply sunscreen and makeup on top of it. Will transition to using it only at night time until i finish the whole thing.

I apply this to clean damp skin and it stings like crazy! It also pills up if you accidentally brush up against your face for any reason. For a high priced brand geared towards sensitive skin this is shockingly bad!
After using this product I decided to try Olay Regenerist basically because it was less expensive…… but I went back to LaRoche Posey …. Better quality and works much better on my face

Bought this as an impulse because nothing else was working for mg dry skin. It goes on light weight but I often add more due to my skin just sucking it up. I noticed change withing a 2-3 days. My skin was noticely smoother. Would reccomend this for absolutly ANYONE. It's lightweight, non-greasy, and lays comfortably if you use it at night like I do!!

I was disappointed with who my skin didn't absorb this moisturizer. It felt like it just sat on top and when I rubbed it in, it flaked off. I used it after cleaning my skin with Cetaphil gentle skin cleanser.
This is great. You only need a tiny amount and it goes a long way.

I'm disappointed. I have sensitive skin and was looking forward to trying this, but after several weeks, but it cases redness all over my face, and it makes my forehead really shiny, but somehow still very dry at the same time.
